fixed_in: File path helpers convert their arguments the way CRuby's FilePathValue/StringValue do (#57)
diff_then: stdout: 'dirname(123) => "."' vs 'dirname(123) => TypeError: no implicit conversion of Integer into String'
note: #57: `File.basename`/`dirname`/`extname`/`join` coerced every path with `to_s`, so a non-String argument answered a value where CRuby raises TypeError. The helpers now resolve a path through `to_path`, then `to_str`, and raise CRuby's byte-exact `no implicit conversion of X into String` otherwise (an anonymous class, whose name carries a native address, gates instead); `basename`'s suffix uses the narrower `StringValue`, and an omitted suffix now differs from an explicit nil. `join` joins nested arrays to Strings first, follows CRuby's separator rule, and raises `ArgumentError: recursive array` on a cycle. The String cases and the modeled Pathname inputs are unchanged.
